features.note: 3 blades at even pitch; middle (drive) blade presents its bright top face while top and bottom blades tilt the opposite way showing edge/dark faces — opposed counter-rotation reads. Attempt-1 state incoherence is fixed: HUD shows APERTURA 30 and blades sit at ~25-30 deg, consistent.

Attempt-1 failure resolved: a plated spindle now protrudes ~3 voxels (~60 mm) clear of the frame right face before the dark U-clamp block, and the orange body hangs offset on it, never flush. A distinct dark flat strap bridges the actuator lower flank to the frame face, separate from the stepped drooping cable below. Strap-to-frame contact could read crisper, hence not higher.

Light disc placeholder with a dark pointer notch now reads at the actuator head on the shaft axis — correct location and granularity for blockout. Printed 0-90 arc still pending (materials-pass item, not penalized); 1:1 rotation unverifiable from a still.
No regression: channel casing keeps real ~0.13 m depth against the 0.60 face width, with front flange ring and rear rail both visible at the top edge. Proportions still match 600x400x127.

Dark vertical tie bar on the left (non-actuator) side spanning the three blade axle heights, with light crank nubs at the pivots. Present and plausibly connected, but it reads somewhat slab-like rather than crank-and-rod; acceptable at blockout, must articulate later.

important_features.note: Dark edge strips read along the blade long edges and meeting lines. Jamb seals at the frame interior side faces read only faintly — dark vertical bands that could be shadow. Threshold shown is the GATES important-average bar, not a spec per-item threshold.
Attempt-1 gap closed: a light rectangular slab placeholder now reads on the orange actuator front face where the printed label will go.
Stepped dark voxels exit the gland area, descend and curve away — reads as a drooping catenary, not a straight rod, and is now visually separate from the strap.

defects: Jamb seals on the frame interior left/right faces read only faintly; at this angle they are hard to distinguish from ambient-occlusion shadow.
Anti-rotation strap is present and distinct from the cable, but its contact patch on the frame right face reads slightly ambiguous — keep the strap and cable clearly separated as they gain form.
Side linkage reads as a flat vertical slab with nubs rather than discrete cranks plus tie rod — fine at blockout, must articulate by the structural pass.
Printed 0-90 indicator arc still absent behind the pointer disc — due at the materials pass, tracked forward from attempt 1.
